commit_message: Run ACP startup outside the Editor presentation thread
pr_title: Keep AI Studio responsive during ACP startup
pr_body:
## Summary

- move ACP provider discovery, process launch, Managed Local endpoint startup, initialization, and session negotiation off the egui presentation thread
- prepare Agent Host bindings before background startup and attach negotiated sessions only after the worker completes
- preserve current ACP MCP permission identity and Agent Host authority while keeping benchmark runtime identity checks before measured work
- cancel background Build startup ownership when the active run is stopped

A follow-up slice adds explicit Ask startup controls, deterministic visual evidence, and the ADR 0166 presentation-thread contract.
